headline: Spatial multiomics resolves tumor niches and recurrence-linked cell states
label: Spatial Multiomics Tumor Profiling
summary: Same-section spatial workflows and foundation models now pair tissue architecture with molecular readouts at single-cell resolution.
synthesis: The dominant thread is spatially resolved profiling of tumor heterogeneity, in which single-cell, spatial, and multi-omic readouts define cell states and microenvironmental niches. Two items couple modalities within one section: IN-DEPTH combines same-slide spatial proteomics-guided transcriptomics with the SGCC cross-correlation framework in EBV-positive and negative DLBCL, and an integrated Xenium and imaging mass cytometry workflow co-registers RNA and protein at single-cell resolution on one FFPE section. AI-guided deep visual proteomics extends this logic by using H&E recurrence-risk maps to direct spatial proteomics in triple-negative breast cancer. The VirTues foundation model handles segmentation, typing, and niche annotation across multiplex spatial proteomics. A spatial review of pancreatic cancer extends the same framing. Other items, including bulk multi-omic subtyping and extracellular vesicle biomarker studies, are not spatially resolved.
